segments.text:
7 Wherefore the kyng cryed loude that they ſhould bring the Aſtrologians, the Chaldeans and ye ſoothſayers. And the king ſayd to the wiſe
men of Babel: Whoſoeuer can read this writing and declare me the interpretation therof ſhalbe clothed with purple, and ſhall haue a chayne of gold about his necke, and ſhalbe the third ruler in the kyngdome.
